column2: # Drop columns that are entirely NA
select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>% # you can read this line as "where not everything is na"
# the ! is the reverse operator (it means 'not')
# the ~ and . are function notations; ~ turns the `!all(is.na(.))` into a function,
# which iterates over the column names, represented by the period (.)
# clean_names from janitor removes capitals, spaces, and weird characters.
